arithmetic.premise: selected initialization path returns normally and page/space/class globals retain selected values; not native boot observation
arithmetic.fill_scope: lengths0..65536 all low3 alignment values; static footprint/algebra only, zero pattern from bzero argument. No pointer/fault/runtime memory proof
arithmetic.noblock_scope: wrapper passes second argument0, but own body may replenish and pageable branch still calls kmem_alloc_pageable; name alone not whole no-sleep guarantee

findings: Original i386_init stores page_size8192 then calls vm_set_page_size; conditional mask8191/shift13. File page_size is0 and common globals are not file-backed runtime values.

vm_mem_init calls vm_page_startup before zone_bootstrap and zone_init before kalloc_init. vm_page_startup replaces zdata_size with8 pages and explicitly bzeroes allocated pool. File initializer size is not runtime pool size.

kalloc_init uses only classes strictly below page_size, mode0 and max1048576; conditional selected classes16..4096. This supplies an original initialization premise for kfree(0,0) first zone but does not prove complete call reachability/native behavior.
zinit rounds element16, page-rounds max/chunk, initializes specific fields, flags=(old&f0)|8|(mode&1). No own all-byte zero or unconditional zone+3c writer.

Space selection changes element and zone+3c only if current_bytes0 and a matching configured backing space exists; no-match preserves existing zone+3c. Bootstrap first zone created before additional spaces; initial zeroed pool matters and cannot generalize to reuse.

zalloc fast path removes head and increments in-use count without clearing returned element; old next DWORD remains. zget only performs head removal, no replenish. Both wrappers zalloc/noblock forward EAX despite void C.

zalloc second argument1 is not unconditional non-NULL guarantee: over-limit flag4 returns local0; other branches wait/replenish/panic under specific flags. Noblock0 can still replenish; no whole no-sleep guarantee from name.

After busy wait and reacquisition local pointer is tested without new head reload on that edge; separate pageable refill path clears busy, wakes waiters, reloads head. Do not silently normalize C to a generic retry-pop algorithm.
Pageable refill creates free-list links and accounting, no full element zero. Nonpageable replenish uses zget_space and panics on zero when wait argument1, returns0 for wait0.
zget_space allocates aligned existing extent, initial zdata tail, or kmem_alloc_zone, retries after unlocked allocation and frees unused new mapping if another extent wins; no own output scrub.
Pool helpers modify extent headers/hints; sorted-list and size invariants, wrap and invalid pointers remain caller contracts. No complete coalescing/lifetime proof.
kmem_alloc_zone local EAX0/1/6 and output-only-success mirror wired contract; passes caller wait parameter to backing helper, whose full VM behavior remains open.
vm_alloc_from_regions successful original EAX is aligned base while EDX is end; void decompiler omits returned address consumed by startup callers.
Initial bzero does not imply zero at every later zone allocation or TSS trailing byte; no runtime memory read, native fault reproduction or emulator used.
